debate.key_bull_argument: Ichimoku tenkan-kijun cross-up with three white soldiers and RSI extreme overbought (80.87) creates textbook short-term reversal setup near support (156.729), offering tight-stop swing entry with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 290.4, strong dollar headwind, negative macro score -8), fundamental score is critically weak (2/10 with zero insider conviction), and price is below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA, making any bounce vulnerable to macro-driven selloff.
